verses.text_uthmani: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ

trs.20: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:
trs.85: [How] prosperous are the believers!
trs.22: The believers must (eventually) win through,-
trs.203: Successful indeed are the believers.

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَـٰشِعُونَ

trs.20: They who are during their prayer humbly intent
trs.85: Those who pray humbly,
trs.22: Those who humble themselves in their prayers;
trs.203: Those who offer their Salât (prayers) with all solemnity and full submissiveness.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ

trs.20: And they who turn away from ill speech
trs.85: who shun idle talk,
trs.22: Who avoid vain talk;
trs.203: And those who turn away from Al-Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk, falsehood, and all that Allâh has forbidden).

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَـٰعِلُونَ

trs.20: And they who are observant of zakāh
trs.85: who pay the prescribed alms,
trs.22: Who are active in deeds of charity;
trs.203: And those who pay the Zakât.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ

trs.20: And they who guard their private parts
trs.85: who guard their chastity
trs.22: Who abstain from sex,
trs.203: And those who guard their chastity (i.e. private parts, from illegal sexual acts)

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ

trs.20: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess,<sup foot_note=196854>1</sup> for indeed, they will not be blamed -
trs.85: except with their spouses or their slaves––with these they are not to blame,
trs.22: Except with those joined to them in the marriage bond, or (the captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (in their case) they are free from blame,
trs.203: Except from their wives or (the slaves) that their right hands possess, - for then, they are free from blame;

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ

trs.20: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -
trs.85: but anyone who seeks more than this is exceeding the limits––
trs.22: But those whose desires exceed those limits are transgressors;-
trs.203: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors;

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ

trs.20: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
trs.85: who are faithful to their trusts and pledges
trs.22: Those who faithfully observe their trusts and their covenants;
trs.203: Those who are faithfully true to their Amanât (all the duties which Allâh has ordained, honesty, moral responsibility and trusts) and to their covenants;

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ

trs.20: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -
trs.85: and who keep up their prayers,
trs.22: And who (strictly) guard their prayers;-
trs.203: And those who strictly guard their (five compulsory congregational) Salawât (prayers) (at their fixed stated hours).

verses.text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ

trs.20: Those are the inheritors
trs.85: will rightly be given
trs.22: These will be the heirs,
trs.203: These are indeed the inheritors

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ

trs.20: Who will inherit al-Firdaus.<sup foot_note=196855>1</sup> They will abide therein eternally.
trs.85: Paradise as their own, there to remain.
trs.22: Who will inherit Paradise: they will dwell therein (for ever).
trs.203: Who shall inherit the Firdaus (Paradise). They shall dwell therein forever.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن سُلَـٰلَةٍ مِّن طِينٍ

trs.20: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
trs.85: We created man from an essence of clay,
trs.22: Man We did create from a quintessence (of clay);
trs.203: And indeed We created man (Adam) out of an extract of clay (water and earth).

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُطْفَةً فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ

trs.20: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop<sup foot_note=196856>1</sup> in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb].
trs.85: then We placed him as a drop of fluid in a safe place,
trs.22: Then We placed him as (a drop of) sperm in a place of rest, firmly fixed;
trs.203: Thereafter We made him (the offspring of Adam) as a Nutfah (mixed drops of the male and female sexual discharge and lodged it) in a safe lodging (womb of the woman).

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَـٰمًا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَـٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ

trs.20: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allāh, the best of creators.<sup foot_note=196857>1</sup>
trs.85: then We made that drop into a clinging form, and We made that form into a lump of flesh, and We made that lump into bones, and We clothed those bones with flesh, and later We made him into other forms––glory be to God, the best of creators!––
trs.22: Then We made the sperm into a clot of congealed blood; then of that clot We made a (foetus) lump; then we made out of that lump bones and clothed the bones with flesh; then we developed out of it another creature. So blessed be Allah, the best to create!
trs.203: Then We made the Nutfah into a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood), then We made the clot into a little lump of flesh, then We made out of that little lump of flesh bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We brought it forth as another creation. So Blessed is Allâh, the Best of creators.<sup foot_note=154741>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ

trs.20: Then indeed, after that you are to die.
trs.85: then you will die
trs.22: After that, at length ye will die
trs.203: After that, surely, you will die.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ

trs.20: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.
trs.85: and then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be raised up again.
trs.22: Again, on the Day of Judgment, will ye be raised up.
trs.203: Then (again), surely, you will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَـٰفِلِينَ

trs.20: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.
trs.85: We created seven levels above you: We are never unmindful of Our creation.
trs.22: And We have made, above you, seven tracts; and We are never unmindful of (our) Creation.
trs.203: And indeed We have created above you seven heavens (one over the other), and We are never unaware of the creation.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّـٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ

trs.20: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.
trs.85: We sent water down from the sky in due measure and lodged it in the earth––We have the power to take it all away if We so wish––
trs.22: And We send down water from the sky according to (due) measure, and We cause it to soak in the soil; and We certainly are able to drain it off (with ease).
trs.203: And We sent down from the sky water (rain) in (due) measure, and We gave it lodging in the earth, and verily, We are Able to take it away.

translation.text: then We cause it to settle

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

trs.20: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.
trs.85: with it We produced for you gardens of date palms and vines, with many fruits there for you to eat,
trs.22: With it We grow for you gardens of date-palms and vines: in them have ye abundant fruits: and of them ye eat (and have enjoyment),-
trs.203: Then We brought forth for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you, and whereof you eat.

verses.text_uthmani: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِّلْـَٔاكِلِينَ

trs.20: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food [i.e., olives] for those who eat.
trs.85: and a tree, growing out of Mount Sinai, that produces oil and seasoning for your food.
trs.22: Also a tree springing out of Mount Sinai, which produces oil, and relish for those who use it for food.
trs.203: And a tree (olive) that springs forth from Mount Sinai, that grows (produces) oil, and (it is a) relish for the eaters.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ لَعِبْرَةً ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

trs.20: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.
trs.85: There is a lesson for you in livestock: We produce milk for you to drink from their bellies. And they have many other benefits: you eat them
trs.22: And in cattle (too) ye have an instructive example: from within their bodies We produce (milk) for you to drink; there are, in them, (besides), numerous (other) benefits for you; and of their (meat) ye eat;
trs.203: And verily in the cattle there is indeed a lesson for you. We give you to drink (milk) of that which is in their bellies. And there are, in them, numerous (other) benefits for you, and of them you eat.

verses.text_uthmani: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ

trs.20: And upon them and on ships you are carried.
trs.85: and you ride on them, as you do in ships.
trs.22: And on them, as well as in ships, ye ride.
trs.203: And on them, and on ships you are carried.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

trs.20: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
trs.85: We sent Noah to his people. He said, ‘My people, serve God, for He is your only god. Will you not heed Him?’
trs.22: (Further, We sent a long line of prophets for your instruction). We sent Noah to his people: He said, "O my people! worship Allah! Ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
trs.203: And indeed We sent Nûh (Noah) to his people, and he said: "O my people! Worship Allâh! You have no other Ilâh (God) but Him (Islâmic Monotheism). Will you not then be afraid (of Him i.e. of His punishment because of worshipping others besides Him)?"

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

trs.20: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allāh had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.
trs.85: But the leading disbelievers among his people said, ‘He is merely a mortal like you, trying to gain some superiority over you. God would have sent down angels if He had wished; besides, we never heard of anything like this from our forefathers.
trs.22: The chiefs of the Unbelievers among his people said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: his wish is to assert his superiority over you: if Allah had wished (to send messengers), He could have sent down angels; never did we hear such a thing (as he says), among our ancestors of old."
trs.203: But the chiefs of his people who disbelieved said: "He is no more than a human being like you, he seeks to make himself superior to you. Had Allâh willed, He surely could have sent down angels. Never did we hear such a thing among our fathers of old.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

trs.20: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."
trs.85: He is just a madman, so let’s wait and see what happens to him.’
trs.22: (And some said): "He is only a man possessed: wait (and have patience) with him for a time."
trs.203: "He is only a man in whom is madness, so wait for him a while."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

trs.20: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
trs.85: Noah said, ‘My Lord, help me! They call me a liar,’
trs.22: (Noah) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood!"
trs.203: [Nûh (Noah)] said: "O my Lord! Help me because they deny me."

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَـٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ

trs.20: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows,<sup foot_note=196858>1</sup> put into it [i.e., the ship] from each [creature] two mates and your family, except him for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.
trs.85: and so We revealed to him: ‘Build the Ark under Our watchful eye and according to Our revelation. When Our command comes and water gushes up out of the earth,take pairs of every species on board, and your family, except for those on whom the sentence has already been passed- do not plead with me for the evildoers: they will be drowned-
trs.22: So We inspired him (with this message): "Construct the Ark within Our sight and under Our guidance: then when comes Our Command, and the fountains of the earth gush forth, take thou on board pairs of every species, male and female, and thy family- except those of them against whom the Word has already gone forth: And address Me not in favour of the wrong-doers; for they shall be drowned (in the Flood).
trs.203: So We revealed to him (saying): "Construct the ship under Our Eyes and under Our Revelation (guidance). Then, when Our Command comes, and water gushes forth from the oven, take on board of each kind two (male and female), and your family, except those thereof against whom the Word has already gone forth. And address Me not in favour of those who have done wrong. Verily, they are to be drowned.

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

trs.20: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allāh who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'
trs.85: and when you and your companions are settled on the Ark, say, “Praise be to God, who delivered us from the wicked people,”
trs.22: And when thou hast embarked on the Ark - thou and those with thee,- say: "Praise be to Allah, Who has saved us from the people who do wrong."
trs.203: And when you have embarked on the ship, you and whoever is with you, then say: "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Who has saved us from the people who are Zâlimûn (i.e. oppressors, wrong-doers, polytheists, those who join others in worship with Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ

trs.20: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].'"
trs.85: and say, “My Lord, let me land with Your blessing: it is You who provide the best landings”.’
trs.22: And say: "O my Lord! enable me to disembark with thy blessing: for Thou art the Best to enable (us) to disembark."
trs.203: And say: "My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for You are the Best of those who bring to land."

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ

trs.20: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].
trs.85: There are signs in all this: We have always put [people] to the test.
trs.22: Verily in this there are Signs (for men to understand); (thus) do We try (men).
trs.203: Verily, in this [what We did as regards drowning of the people of Nûh (Noah)], there are indeed Ayât (proofs, evidence, lessons, signs, etc. for men to understand), for sure We are ever putting (men) to the test.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ

trs.20: Then We produced after them a generation of others.
trs.85: Then We raised another generation after them,
trs.22: Then We raised after them another generation.
trs.203: Then, after them, We created another generation.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

trs.20: And We sent among them a messenger<sup foot_note=196859>1</sup> from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
trs.85: and sent one of their own as a messenger: ‘Serve God, for He is your only god. Will you not heed Him?’
trs.22: And We sent to them a messenger from among themselves, (saying), "Worship Allah! ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
trs.203: And We sent to them a Messenger from among themselves (saying): "Worship Allâh! You have no other Ilâh (God) but Him. Will you not then be afraid (of Him i.e. of His punishment because of worshipping others besides Him)?"

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ

trs.20: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.
trs.85: But the leading disbelievers among his people, who denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, to whom We had granted ease and plenty in this life, said, ‘He is just a mortal like you- he eats what you eat and drinks what you drink-
trs.22: And the chiefs of his people, who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and on whom We had bestowed the good things of this life, said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: he eats of that of which ye eat, and drinks of what ye drink.
trs.203: And the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and whom We had given the luxuries and comforts of this life, said: "He is no more than a human being like you, he eats of that which you eat, and drinks of what you drink.

translation.text: while We had given them luxury

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّخَـٰسِرُونَ

trs.20: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
trs.85: and you will really be losers if you obey a mortal like yourselves.
trs.22: "If ye obey a man like yourselves, behold, it is certain ye will be lost.
trs.203: "If you were to obey a human being like yourselves, then verily you indeed would be losers.

verses.text_uthmani: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ

trs.20: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
trs.85: How can he promise you that after you die and become dust and bones you will be brought out alive?
trs.22: "Does he promise that when ye die and become dust and bones, ye shall be brought forth (again)?
trs.203: "Does he promise you that when you have died and have become dust and bones, you shall come out alive (resurrected)?

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ

trs.20: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.<sup foot_note=196860>1</sup>
trs.85: What you are promised is very farfetched.
trs.22: "Far, very far is that which ye are promised!
trs.203: "Far, very far is that which you are promised!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ

trs.20: It [i.e., life] is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
trs.85: There is only the life of this world: we die, we live, but we will never be resurrected.
trs.22: "There is nothing but our life in this world! We shall die and we live! But we shall never be raised up again!
trs.203: "There is nothing but our life of this world! We die and we live! And we are not going to be resurrected!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allāh, and we will not believe him."
trs.85: He is just a man making lies up about God. We will never believe in him.’
trs.22: "He is only a man who invents a lie against Allah, but we are not the ones to believe in him!"
trs.203: "He is only a man who has invented a lie against Allâh, and we are not going to believe in him."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ

trs.20: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
trs.85: The prophet said, ‘My Lord, help me! They call me a liar,’
trs.22: (The prophet) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood."
trs.203: He said: "O my Lord! Help me because they deny me."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَـٰدِمِينَ

trs.20: [Allāh] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."
trs.85: and so God said, ‘Soon they will be filled with regret.’
trs.22: (Allah) said: "In but a little while, they are sure to be sorry!"
trs.203: (Allâh) said: "In a little while, they are sure to be regretful."

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ غُثَآءً ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

trs.20: So the shriek<sup foot_note=196862>1</sup> seized them in truth,<sup foot_note=196861>2</sup> and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
trs.85: The blast justly struck them and We swept them away like scum. Away with the evildoers!
trs.22: Then the Blast overtook them with justice, and We made them as rubbish of dead leaves (floating on the stream of Time)! So away with the people who do wrong!
trs.203: So As-Saihah (torment - awful cry) overtook them in truth (with justice), and We made them as rubbish of dead plants. So away with the people who are Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh, disobedient to His Messengers).

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ

trs.20: Then We produced after them other generations.
trs.85: We raised other generations after them-
trs.22: Then We raised after them other generations.
trs.203: Then, after them, We created other generations.

verses.text_uthmani: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ

trs.20: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].
trs.85: no community can advance or delay its time-
trs.22: No people can hasten their term, nor can they delay (it).
trs.203: No nation can advance their term, nor can they delay it.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةً رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّقَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

trs.20: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations.<sup foot_note=196863>1</sup> So away with a people who do not believe.
trs.85: and We sent Our messengers in succession: whenever a messenger came to a community they invariably called him a liar, so We destroyed them one after the other and made them into cautionary tales. Away with the disbelievers!
trs.22: Then sent We our messengers in succession: every time there came to a people their messenger, they accused him of falsehood: so We made them follow each other (in punishment): We made them as a tale (that is told): So away with a people that will not believe!
trs.203: Then We sent Our Messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation their Messenger, they denied him; so We made them follow one another (to destruction), and We made them as Ahadîth (the true stories for mankind to learn a lesson from them). So away with a people who believe not!

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

trs.20: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority<sup foot_note=196864>1</sup>
trs.85: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our signs and clear authority,
trs.22: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our Signs and authority manifest,
trs.203: Then We sent Mûsa (Moses) and his brother Hârûn‎‎ (Aaron), with Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and manifest authority,

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ

trs.20: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
trs.85: to Pharaoh and his prominent leaders, but they responded with arrogance: they were a haughty people.
trs.22: To Pharaoh and his Chiefs: But these behaved insolently: they were an arrogant people.
trs.203: To Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs, but they behaved insolently and they were people self-exalting (by disobeying their Lord, and exalting themselves over and above the Messenger of Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَـٰبِدُونَ

trs.20: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"
trs.85: They said, ‘Are we to believe in two mortals like us? And their people are our servants?’
trs.22: They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves? And their people are subject to us!"
trs.203: They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves, and their people are obedient to us with humility (and we use them to serve us as we like)."

verses.text_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ

trs.20: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.
trs.85: and so they called them both liars: they became another ruined people.
trs.22: So they accused them of falsehood, and they became of those who were destroyed.
trs.203: So they denied them both [Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron)] and became of those who were destroyed.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

trs.20: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they<sup foot_note=196865>1</sup> would be guided.
trs.85: We gave Moses the Scripture, so that they might be rightly guided.
trs.22: And We gave Moses the Book, in order that they might receive guidance.
trs.203: And indeed We gave Mûsâ (Moses) the Scripture, that they may be guided.

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةً وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ

trs.20: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
trs.85: We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign; We gave them shelter on a peaceful hillside with flowing water.
trs.22: And We made the son of Mary and his mother as a Sign: We gave them both shelter on high ground, affording rest and security and furnished with springs.
trs.203: And We made the son of Maryam (Mary) and his mother as a sign, and We gave them refuge on high ground, a place of rest, security and flowing streams.

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ

trs.20: [Allāh said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Knowing.
trs.85: Messengers, eat good things and do good deeds: I am well aware of what you do.
trs.22: O ye messengers! enjoy (all) things good and pure, and work righteousness: for I am well-acquainted with (all) that ye do.
trs.203: O (you) Messengers! Eat of the Tayyibât [all kinds of Halâl foods which Allâh has made lawful (meat of slaughtered eatable animals, milk products, fats, vegetables, fruits, etc.] and do righteous deeds. Verily! I am Well-Acquainted with what you do.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ

trs.20: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion,<sup foot_note=196866>1</sup> and I am your Lord, so fear Me."
trs.85: This community of yours is one- and I am your Lord: be mindful of Me-
trs.22: And verily this Brotherhood of yours is a single Brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore fear Me (and no other).
trs.203: And verily this your religion (of Islâmic Monotheism) is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear (keep your duty to) Me.

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ

trs.20: But they [i.e., the people] divided their religion among them into portions [i.e., sects] - each faction, in what it has,<sup foot_note=196867>1</sup> rejoicing.
trs.85: but they have split their community into sects, each rejoicing in their own.
trs.22: But people have cut off their affair (of unity), between them, into sects: each party rejoices in that which is with itself.
trs.203: But they (men) have broken their religion among them into sects,<sup foot_note=154742>1</sup> each group rejoicing in what is with it (as its beliefs).

verses.text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

trs.20: So leave them in their confusion for a time.
trs.85: So [Muhammad] leave them for a while steeped [in their ignorance].
trs.22: But leave them in their confused ignorance for a time.
trs.203: So leave them in their error for a time.

verses.text_uthmani: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍ وَبَنِينَ

trs.20: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
trs.85: Do they reckon that, by giving them wealth and sons,
trs.22: Do they think that because We have granted them abundance of wealth and sons,
trs.203: Do they think that in wealth and children with which We enlarge them

verses.text_uthmani: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ

trs.20: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.<sup foot_note=196868>1</sup>
trs.85: We race to give them good things? They really have no idea!
trs.22: We would hasten them on in every good? Nay, they do not understand.
trs.203: We hasten unto them with good things. Nay, [it is a Fitnah (trial) in this worldly life so that they will have no share of good things in the Hereafter] but they perceive not. [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi].

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ

trs.20: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
trs.85: Those who stand in awe of their Lord,
trs.22: Verily those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;
trs.203: Verily those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ

trs.20: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
trs.85: who believe in His messages,
trs.22: Those who believe in the Signs of their Lord;
trs.203: And those who believe in the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord;

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ

trs.20: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
trs.85: who do not ascribe partners to Him,
trs.22: Those who join not (in worship) partners with their Lord;
trs.203: And those who join not anyone (in worship) as partners with their Lord;

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ

trs.20: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful<sup foot_note=196869>1</sup> because they will be returning to their Lord -
trs.85: who always give with hearts that tremble at the thought that they must return to Him,
trs.22: And those who dispense their charity with their hearts full of fear, because they will return to their Lord;-
trs.203: And those who give that (their charity) which they give (and also do other good deeds) with their hearts full of fear (whether their alms and charities have been accepted or not),<sup foot_note=154743>1</sup> because they are sure to return to their Lord (for reckoning).

verses.text_uthmani: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَـٰبِقُونَ

trs.20: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
trs.85: are the ones who race toward good things, and they will be the first to get them.
trs.22: It is these who hasten in every good work, and these who are foremost in them.
trs.203: It is these who hasten in the good deeds, and they are foremost in them [e.g. offering the compulsory Salât (prayers) in their (early) stated, fixed times and so on].

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَـٰبٌ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

trs.20: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
trs.85: We do not burden any soul with more than it can bear- We have a Record that tells the truth- they will not be wronged.
trs.22: On no soul do We place a burden greater than it can bear: before Us is a record which clearly shows the truth: they will never be wronged.
trs.203: And We task not any person except according to his capacity, and with Us is a Record which speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged.

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَـٰلٌ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَـٰمِلُونَ

trs.20: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides that [i.e., disbelief] which they are doing,
trs.85: But the disbelievers’ hearts are steeped [in ignorance of ] all this; and there are other things besides this that they do.
trs.22: But their hearts are in confused ignorance of this; and there are, besides that, deeds of theirs, which they will (continue) to do,-
trs.203: Nay, but their hearts are covered from (understanding) this (the Qur’ân), and they have other (evil) deeds, besides, which they are doing.

verses.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ

trs.20: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment,<sup foot_note=196870>1</sup> at once they are crying [to Allāh] for help.
trs.85: When We bring Our punishment on those corrupted with wealth, they will cry for help:
trs.22: Until, when We seize in Punishment those of them who received the good things of this world, behold, they will groan in supplication!
trs.203: Until when We seize those of them who lead a luxurious life with punishment: behold they make humble invocation with a loud voice.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ

trs.20: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
trs.85: ‘Do not cry out today: you will get no help from Us.
trs.22: (It will be said): "Groan not in supplication this day: for ye shall certainly not be helped by Us.
trs.203: Invoke not loudly this day! Certainly you shall not be helped by Us.

verses.text_uthmani: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَـٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ

trs.20: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels.
trs.85: Time and time again My messages were recited to you, but you turned arrogantly on your heels,
trs.22: "My Signs used to be rehearsed to you, but ye used to turn back on your heels-
trs.203: Indeed My Verses used to be recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels (denying them, and refusing with hatred to listen to them).

verses.text_uthmani: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَـٰمِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ

trs.20: In arrogance regarding it,<sup foot_note=196871>1</sup> conversing by night, speaking evil.
trs.85: and spent the evening making fun of [the Quran].’
trs.22: "In arrogance: talking nonsense about the (Qur'an), like one telling fables by night."
trs.203: In pride (they - Quraish pagans and polytheists of Makkah used to feel proud that they are the dwellers of Makkah sanctuary - Haram), talking evil about it (the Qur’ân) by night.

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

trs.20: Then have they not reflected over the word [i.e., the Qur’ān], or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
trs.85: Have they not contemplated the Word of God? Has something come to them that did not come to their forefathers?
trs.22: Do they not ponder over the Word (of Allah), or has anything (new) come to them that did not come to their fathers of old?
trs.203: Have they not pondered over the Word (of Allâh, i.e. what is sent down to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم), or has there come to them what had not come to their fathers of old?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

trs.20: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?
trs.85: Do they not recognize their Messenger? So why do they reject him?
trs.22: Or do they not recognise their Messenger, that they deny him?
trs.203: Or is it that they did not recognize their Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) so they deny him?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ

trs.20: Or do they say, "In him is madness"? Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
trs.85: Why do they say he is possessed? He has brought them the truth and most of them hate it,
trs.22: Or do they say, "He is possessed"? Nay, he has brought them the Truth, but most of them hate the Truth.
trs.203: Or say they: There is madness in him? Nay, but he brought them the truth [i.e. Tauhîd: Worshipping Allâh Alone in all aspects, the Qur’ân and the religion of Islâm], but most of them (the disbelievers) are averse to the truth.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ

trs.20: But if the Truth [i.e., Allāh] had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message,<sup foot_note=196872>1</sup> but they, from their message, are turning away.
trs.85: but if the truth were in accordance with their desires, the heavens, the earth, and everyone in them would disintegrate. We have brought them their Reminder and they turn away from it.
trs.22: If the Truth had been in accord with their desires, truly the heavens and the earth, and all beings therein would have been in confusion and corruption! Nay, We have sent them their admonition, but they turn away from their admonition.
trs.203: And if the truth had been in accordance with their desires, verily, the heavens and the earth, and whosoever is therein would have been corrupted! Nay, We have brought them their reminder, but they turn away from their reminder.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ

trs.20: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.
trs.85: Do you [Prophet] ask them for any payment? Your Lord’s is the best payment: He is the Best of Providers.
trs.22: Or is it that thou askest them for some recompense? But the recompense of thy Lord is best: He is the Best of those who give sustenance.
trs.203: Or is it that you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) ask them for some wages? But the recompense of your Lord is better, and He is the Best of those who give sustenance.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

trs.20: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.
trs.85: You call them to a straight path
trs.22: But verily thou callest them to the Straight Way;
trs.203: And certainly, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) call them to the Straight Path (true religion - Islâmic Monotheism).

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَـٰكِبُونَ

trs.20: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
trs.85: and those who do not believe in the Hereafter turn away from that path.
trs.22: And verily those who believe not in the Hereafter are deviating from that Way.
trs.203: And verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed deviating far astray from the Path (true religion - Islâmic Monotheism).

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَـٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَـٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

trs.20: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
trs.85: Even if We were to show them mercy and relieve them of distress, they would blindly persist in their transgression.
trs.22: If We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering in distraction to and fro.
trs.203: And though We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, still they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ

trs.20: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
trs.85: We have already afflicted them, yet they did not submit to their Lord: they will not humble themselves
trs.22: We inflicted Punishment on them, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor do they submissively entreat (Him)!-
trs.203: And indeed We seized them with punishment, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor did they invoke (Allâh) with submission to Him.

verses.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ

trs.20: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.
trs.85: until We open a gate to severe torment for them- then they will be plunged into utter despair.
trs.22: Until We open on them a gate leading to a severe Punishment: then Lo! they will be plunged in despair therein!
trs.203: Until, when We open for them the gate of severe punishment, then lo! they will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair.

verses.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ

trs.20: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
trs.85: It is God who endowed you with hearing, sight, and hearts- how seldom you are grateful!
trs.22: It is He Who has created for you (the faculties of) hearing, sight, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give!
trs.203: It is He Who has created for you (the sense of) hearing (ears), eyes (sight), and hearts (understanding). Little thanks you give.

verses.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

trs.20: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
trs.85: It is He who made you multiply on earth. It is to Him that you will be gathered:
trs.22: And He has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered back.
trs.203: And it is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him you shall be gathered back.

verses.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَـٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

trs.20: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
trs.85: it is He who gives life and death; the alternation of night and day depends on Him; will you not use your minds?
trs.22: It is He Who gives life and death, and to Him (is due) the alternation of Night and Day: will ye not then understand?
trs.203: And it is He Who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of night and day. Will you not then understand?

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ

trs.20: Rather,<sup foot_note=196873>1</sup> they say like what the former peoples said.
trs.85: But, like others before them,
trs.22: On the contrary they say things similar to what the ancients said.
trs.203: Nay, but they say the like of what the men of old said.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

trs.20: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
trs.85: they say, ‘What? When we die and turn to dust and bones, shall we really be resurrected?
trs.22: They say: "What! when we die and become dust and bones, could we really be raised up again?
trs.203: They said: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected indeed?

verses.text_uthmani: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَـٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

trs.20: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."
trs.85: We have heard such promises before, and so did our forefathers. These are just ancient fables.’
trs.22: "Such things have been promised to us and to our fathers before! they are nothing but tales of the ancients!"
trs.203: "Verily, this we have been promised - we and our fathers before (us)! This is only the tales of the ancients!"

verses.text_uthmani: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

trs.20: Say, [O Muḥammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"
trs.85: Say [Prophet], ‘Who owns the earth and all who live in it, if you know [so much]?’
trs.22: Say: "To whom belong the earth and all beings therein? (say) if ye know!"
trs.203: Say: "Whose is the earth and whosoever is therein? If you know!"

verses.text_uthmani: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

trs.20: They will say, "To Allāh." Say, "Then will you not remember?"
trs.85: and they will reply, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Will you not take heed?’
trs.22: They will say, "To Allah!" say: "Yet will ye not receive admonition?"
trs.203: They will say: "It is Allâh’s!" Say: "Will you not then remember?"

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

trs.20: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"
trs.85: Say, ‘Who is the Lord of the seven heavens? Who is the Lord of the Mighty Throne?’
trs.22: Say: "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and the Lord of the Throne (of Glory) Supreme?"
trs.203: Say: "Who is (the) Lord of the seven heavens, and (the) Lord of the Great Throne?"

verses.text_uthmani: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

trs.20: They will say, "[They belong] to Allāh." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"
trs.85: and they will reply, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Will you not be mindful?’
trs.22: They will say, "(They belong) to Allah." Say: "Will ye not then be filled with awe?"
trs.203: They will say: "Allâh." Say: "Will you not then fear Allâh (believe in His Oneness, obey Him, believe in the Resurrection and Recompense for every good or bad deed)?"

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

trs.20: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"
trs.85: Say, ‘Who holds control of everything in His hand? Who protects, while there is no protection against Him, if you know [so much]?’
trs.22: Say: "Who is it in whose hands is the governance of all things,- who protects (all), but is not protected (of any)? (say) if ye know."
trs.203: Say "In Whose Hand is the sovereignty of everything (i.e. treasures of each and everything)? And He protects (all), while against Whom there is no protector, (i.e. if Allâh saves anyone none can punish or harm him, and if Allâh punishes or harms anyone none can save him), if you know?" [Tafsir Al-Qurtubî]

verses.text_uthmani: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ

trs.20: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allāh." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"
trs.85: and they will reply, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Then how can you be so deluded?’
trs.22: They will say, "(It belongs) to Allah." Say: "Then how are ye deluded?"
trs.203: They will say: "(All that belongs) to Allâh." Say: "How then are you deceived and turn away from the truth?"

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ أَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ

trs.20: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.
trs.85: The fact is, We brought them the truth and they are lying.
trs.22: We have sent them the Truth: but they indeed practise falsehood!
trs.203: Nay, but We have brought them the truth (Islâmic Monotheism), and verily, they (disbelievers) are liars.

verses.text_uthmani: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ ۚ إِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَـٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

trs.20: Allāh has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have [sought to] overcome others. Exalted is Allāh above what they describe [concerning Him].
trs.85: God has never had a child. Nor is there any god beside Him- if there were, each god would have taken his creation aside and tried to overcome the others. May God be exalted above what they describe!
trs.22: No son did Allah beget, nor is there any god along with Him: (if there were many gods), behold, each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have lorded it over others! Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the (sort of) things they attribute to Him!
trs.203: No son (or offspring) did Allâh beget, nor is there any ilâh (god) along with Him. (If there had been many gods), then each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have tried to overcome others! Glorified be Allâh above all that they attribute to Him!

verses.text_uthmani: عَـٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ فَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

trs.20: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].
trs.85: He knows what is not seen as well as what is seen; He is far above any partner they claim for Him.
trs.22: He knows what is hidden and what is open: too high is He for the partners they attribute to Him!
trs.203: All-Knower of the unseen and the seen! Exalted be He over all that they associate as partners to Him!

verses.text_uthmani: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ

trs.20: Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,
trs.85: Say, ‘Lord, if You are going to show me the punishment You have promised them,
trs.22: Say: "O my Lord! if Thou wilt show me (in my lifetime) that which they are warned against,-
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "My Lord! If You would show me that with which they are threatened (torment),

verses.text_uthmani: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

trs.20: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
trs.85: then Lord, do not include me among the evildoers!’
trs.22: "Then, O my Lord! put me not amongst the people who do wrong!"
trs.203: "My Lord! Then (save me from Your punishment), put me not amongst the people who are the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers)."

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ

trs.20: And indeed, We are Able to show you what We have promised them.
trs.85: We certainly are able to show you the punishment We have promised them.
trs.22: And We are certainly able to show thee (in fulfilment) that against which they are warned.
trs.203: And indeed We are Able to show you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) that with which We have threatened them.

verses.text_uthmani: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ

trs.20: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
trs.85: Repel evil with good- We are well aware of what they attribute to Us-
trs.22: Repel evil with that which is best: We are well acquainted with the things they say.
trs.203: Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best-Acquainted with the things they utter.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ

trs.20: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,
trs.85: and say, ‘Lord, I take refuge with You from the goadings of the evil ones;
trs.22: And say "O my Lord! I seek refuge with Thee from the suggestions of the Evil Ones.
trs.203: And say: "My Lord! I seek refuge with You from the whisperings (suggestions) of the Shayâtîn (devils).

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ

trs.20: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."
trs.85: I seek refuge with you, Lord, so that they may not come near me.’
trs.22: "And I seek refuge with Thee O my Lord! lest they should come near me."
trs.203: "And I seek refuge with You, My Lord! lest they should come near me."

verses.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ

trs.20: [For such is the state of the disbelievers] until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back
trs.85: When death comes to one of them, he cries, ‘My Lord, let me return
trs.22: (In Falsehood will they be) Until, when death comes to one of them, he says: "O my Lord! send me back (to life),-
trs.203: Until, when death comes to one of them (those who join partners with Allâh), he says: "My Lord! Send me back,

verses.text_uthmani: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَـٰلِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

trs.20: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind."<sup foot_note=196874>1</sup> No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
trs.85: so as to make amends for the things I neglected.’ Never! This will not go beyond his words: a barrier stands behind such people until the very Day they are resurrected.
trs.22: "In order that I may work righteousness in the things I neglected." - "By no means! It is but a word he says."- Before them is a Partition till the Day they are raised up.
trs.203: "So that I may do good in that which I have left behind!" No! It is but a word that he speaks; and behind them is Barzakh (a barrier) until the Day when they will be resurrected.

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

trs.20: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.
trs.85: On that Day when the Trumpet is blown, the ties between them will be as nothing and they will not ask about each other:
trs.22: Then when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no more relationships between them that Day, nor will one ask after another!
trs.203: Then, when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no kinship among them that Day, nor will they ask of one another.

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ

trs.20: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
trs.85: those whose good deeds weigh heavy will be successful,
trs.22: Then those whose balance (of good deeds) is heavy,- they will attain salvation:
trs.203: Then, those whose scales (of good deeds) are heavy, they are the successful.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ

trs.20: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.
trs.85: but those whose balance is light will have lost their souls for ever and will stay in Hell-
trs.22: But those whose balance is light, will be those who have lost their souls, in Hell will they abide.
trs.203: And those whose scales (of good deeds) are light, they are those who lose their ownselves, in Hell will they abide.

verses.text_uthmani: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَـٰلِحُونَ

trs.20: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.<sup foot_note=196875>1</sup>
trs.85: the Fire will scorch their faces and their lips will be twisted in pain.
trs.22: The Fire will burn their faces, and they will therein grin, with their lips displaced.
trs.203: The Fire will burn their faces, and therein they will grin, with displaced lips (disfigured).

verses.text_uthmani: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

trs.20: [It will be said], "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"
trs.85: ‘Were My messages not recited over and over to you and still you rejected them?’
trs.22: "Were not My Signs rehearsed to you, and ye did but treat them as falsehood?"
trs.203: "Were not My Verses (this Qur’ân) recited to you, and then you used to deny them?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَآلِّينَ

trs.20: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
trs.85: They will say, ‘Lord, our waywardness overcame us and we went astray.
trs.22: They will say: "our Lord! Our misfortune overwhelmed us, and we became a people astray!
trs.203: They will say: "Our Lord! Our wretchedness overcame us, and we were (an) erring people.

verses.text_uthmani: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَـٰلِمُونَ

trs.20: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
trs.85: Lord, take us away from this and if we go back to our old ways, then we shall really be evildoers.’
trs.22: "Our Lord! bring us out of this: if ever we return (to Evil), then shall we be wrong-doers indeed!"
trs.203: "Our Lord! Bring us out of this. If ever we return (to evil), then indeed we shall be Zâlimûn: (polytheists, oppressors, unjust, and wrong-doers)."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ

trs.20: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
trs.85: He will say, ‘Away with you! In you go! Do not speak to Me!
trs.22: He will say: "Be ye driven into it (with ignominy)! And speak ye not to Me!
trs.203: He (Allâh) will say: "Remain you in it with ignominy! And speak you not to Me!"

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

trs.20: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
trs.85: Among My servants there were those who said, “Lord, We believe. Forgive us and have mercy on us: You are the most merciful of all.”
trs.22: "A part of My servants there was, who used to pray 'our Lord! we believe; then do Thou forgive us, and have mercy upon us: For Thou art the Best of those who show mercy!"
trs.203: Verily there was a party of My slaves, who used to say: "Our Lord! We believe, so forgive us, and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of all who show mercy!"

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ

trs.20: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
trs.85: But you kept on laughing at them: so intent were you on laughing at them that it made you forget My warning.
trs.22: "But ye treated them with ridicule, so much so that (ridicule of) them made you forget My Message while ye were laughing at them!
trs.203: But you took them for a laughing stock, so much so that they made you forget My Remembrance while you used to laugh at them!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ

trs.20: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."
trs.85: Today I have rewarded them for their patience: it is they who will succeed.’
trs.22: "I have rewarded them this Day for their patience and constancy: they are indeed the ones that have achieved Bliss..."
trs.203: Verily I have rewarded them this Day for their patience: they are indeed the ones that are successful.

verses.text_uthmani: قَـٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ

trs.20: [Allāh] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
trs.85: He will say, ‘How many years were you on earth?’
trs.22: He will say: "What number of years did ye stay on earth?"
trs.203: He (Allâh) will say: "What number of years did you stay on earth?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ

trs.20: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."
trs.85: and they will reply, ‘We stayed a day or a part of a day, but ask those who keep count.’
trs.22: They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day: but ask those who keep account."
trs.203: They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep account."

verses.text_uthmani: قَـٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

trs.20: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.
trs.85: He will say, ‘You stayed but a little, if you had only known.
trs.22: He will say: "Ye stayed not but a little,- if ye had only known!
trs.203: He (Allâh) will say: "You stayed not but a little, if you had only known!

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ

trs.20: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
trs.85: Did you think We had created you in vain, and that you would not be brought back to Us?’
trs.22: "Did ye then think that We had created you in jest, and that ye would not be brought back to Us (for account)?"
trs.203: "Did you think that We had created you in play (without any purpose), and that you would not be brought back to Us?"

verses.text_uthmani: فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ

trs.20: So exalted is Allāh, the Sovereign,<sup foot_note=196877>1</sup> the Truth;<sup foot_note=196876>2</sup> there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
trs.85: Exalted be God, the true King, there is no god but Him, the Lord of the Glorious Throne!
trs.22: Therefore exalted be Allah, the King, the Reality: there is no god but He, the Lord of the Throne of Honour!
trs.203: So Exalted be Allâh, the True King: Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He), the Lord of the Supreme Throne!

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَـٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ

trs.20: And whoever invokes besides Allāh another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
trs.85: Whoever prays to another god alongside Him- a god for whose existence he has no evidence- will face his reckoning with his Lord. Those who reject the truth will not prosper.
trs.22: If anyone invokes, besides Allah, Any other god, he has no authority therefor; and his reckoning will be only with his Lord! and verily the Unbelievers will fail to win through!
trs.203: And whoever invokes (or worships), besides Allâh, any other ilâh (god), of whom he has no proof; then his reckoning is only with his Lord. Surely! Al-Kâfirûn (the disbelievers in Allâh and in the Oneness of Allâh, polytheists, pagans, idolaters) will not be successful.

verses.text_uthmani: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

trs.20: And, [O Muḥammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
trs.85: Say [Prophet], ‘Lord, forgive and have mercy: You are the most merciful of all.’
trs.22: So say: "O my Lord! grant Thou forgiveness and mercy for Thou art the Best of those who show mercy!"
trs.203: And say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the Best of those who show mercy!"
